evidence_scope: official Shopify Theme Store vendor release notes and first-party vendor marketing; NOT competitor live storefront HTML, NOT executed VSN functional QA

checks.observed_vendor_note: Vision 18.0.0 September 29 release notes describe a fix to quantity/remove affecting wrong cart lines after apps add or remove cart items.
checks.original_vsn_design_rule: VSN cart line mutations must use current Shopify line identity/key from latest cart, not stale client indices; debounce and reconcile API responses.
checks.planned_qa: Cart fixtures: same SKU with differing selling plans/properties; app-placed lines, discounts and rapid concurrent quantity/remove; verify only intended line changes.

checks.observed_vendor_note: Vision 18.0.0 adds a mobile shortcut dock; vendor doesn't demonstrate VSN rendering or viewport behavior.
checks.original_vsn_design_rule: Coordinate mobile dock with sticky Add to Cart, chat/reviews embeds, browser safe area and 320px/360px viewports. Hide or reposition competing fixed bars.
checks.planned_qa: Manual phone small viewport with keyboard, expanded cart drawer and reduced motion; assert no clipped action or overlapping click targets.

checks.observed_vendor_note: Vision 18.0.0 fixes desktop mega menus exceeding viewport height being cut off at the bottom.
checks.original_vsn_design_rule: Limit menu max-height relative to visual viewport and make internal contents scrollable; preserve visible focus/escape behavior and original menu promotional tiles.
checks.planned_qa: Small-height desktop viewport at 1024x600 with keyboard tabbing, RTL, browser zoom 200%; ensure no clipped menu actions.

checks.observed_vendor_note: Vision 18.0.0 notes Shopify standard events schema alignment to restore complete pixel/analytics app data.
checks.original_vsn_design_rule: Treat event names/payload/quantity/variant as versioned Shopify specification; emit only meaningful events after successful completed action, never from hidden demo modal markup.
checks.planned_qa: Instrument Shopify standard pixel sandbox; compare valid add-to-cart and product-view event payloads vs Ajax cart state; no duplicate event on section rerender.

checks.observed_vendor_note: Ignite 2.7.0 September 9 vendor release introduces Compatibility Finder / My Garage for auto parts and expanded product schema; feature availability may vary by storefront/version.
checks.original_vsn_design_rule: Treat car fitment as structured merchant-verified make/model/year/SKU data and filter state, not freeform global promises; separate customer saved vehicle persistence from theme concerns.
checks.planned_qa: QA incompatible fitment, missing attributes, customer context, markets, 250+ variants, semantic announcement; do not claim VSN built the finder.

checks.observed_vendor_note: Ignite 2.7.0 release claims extendable product page schema, custom icon uploads, 18 new icons and SEO/GEO improvements.
checks.original_vsn_design_rule: Original VSN product sections must be merchant-editable, with accessible icons, semantic markup, dynamically sourced facts and app-slot compatibility; no automatic AI ranking claims.
checks.planned_qa: Compile and inspect sections/*.liquid, Theme Editor add/reorder/removal, Alt/text labels, canonical product title, structured data duplication, app block compatibility.

checks.observed_vendor_note: Sleek 2.3.0 June 16 Shopify official release notes feature redesigned search drawer, collection promotion blocks and multi-currency shipping goals.
checks.original_vsn_design_rule: Separate search results from advertisements; match free-shipping progress to selected market/currency and actual shipping policy; avoid fabricated thresholds.
checks.planned_qa: Search no results/keyboard/RTL; changing country/currency with existing cart; eligible/ineligible shipping regions and promotion card semantics.

checks.observed_vendor_note: FoxEcom markets immersive motion sections and official Sleek v2.3.0 notes global motion controls.
checks.original_vsn_design_rule: Expose token-based motion defaults, respect prefers-reduced-motion and keyboard/low-power device usability, avoid motion-only controls.
checks.planned_qa: Reduced motion / touch / resize / quick view animations without scroll lock or focus loss.

notes: Vision vendor v18.0.0 published 2026-09-29; Ignite 2.7.0 2026-09-09; Sleek Shopify official listing v2.3.0 released 2026-06-16 in an indexed listing, not asserted as its newest release today.
Company-supplied release notes do not prove that the VSN theme currently has a bug or already supports a feature.
